title: Micro Commit Agent For Cursor
description: Create .cursor/agents/micro-commit.md and .agents/skills/micro-commit/SKILL.md for fast WIP micro-commits: bump counter, parent wip header, timestamp, git diff summaries. Triggers: g, go, c, commit, +1.
summary: Added Cursor subagent `.cursor/agents/micro-commit.md` for one-turn WIP micro-commits: preserves parent 🎆🌙☀️ wip date, bumps 3-digit 🚩 counter, stamps ⏰⌚⏱️ second line, summarizes git diffs into emoji bullets, commits on g/go/c/commit/+1 on ⛳wip or 🏗️dev branches. Added `.agents/skills/micro-commit/SKILL.md` for explicit @micro-commit / skill invocation.
